def tokenize(src):
  tokens=[]; i=0; n=len(src)
  while i<n:
    c=src[i]
    if c in ' \t\n': i+=1; continue
    pos=i
    if c.isdigit():
       j=i+1
       while j<n and src[j].isdigit(): j+=1
       num_str=src[i:j]
       if num_str[0]=='0' and len(num_str)>1: tokens.append(('ERR', None, pos))
       else: tokens.append(('NUM', int(num_str), pos))
       i=j
       continue
    if c.isalpha() or c=='_':
       j=i+1
       while j<n and (src[j].isalnum() or src[j]=='_'): j+=1
       word=src[i:j]
       if word=='true': tokens.append(('BOOL', True, pos))
       elif word=='false': tokens.append(('BOOL', False, pos))
       else: tokens.append(('IDENT', word, pos))
       i=j; continue
    # operators
    two = src[i:i+2]
    if two in ('||','&&','==','!=','<=','>=','**'):
       tokens.append(('OP', two, pos)); i+=2; continue
    if c in '!<>+-*/%?():,':
       tokens.append(('OP', c, pos)); i+=1; continue
    # any other char (includes & | = single, $, etc)
    tokens.append(('ERR', None, pos)); i+=1
  tokens.append(('END', None, n))
  return tokens

    n=len(src); i=0; tokens=[]

       c=src[i]
